evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a calendar date only (YYYY-MM-DD).
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/3 {"dueDate":"2026-01-05"} returned 200 and the date changed. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "15.10.2026" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-13-01" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 UTC. I created todos with due dates of yesterday, today and a future date, one with no due date, and one past-due todo marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-14. The today, future, no-date and done-past todos were excluded.
evidence.AC5: Page / showed each due date in the list: 'past – 14.10.2026', 'today – 15.10.2026', 'future – 01.12.2026', 'pastdone ✓ – 01.01.2026'. The todo without a due date showed only its title.
evidence.AC6: Only 'past – 14.10.2026 (überfällig)' carried the word 'überfällig'. The today, future, no-date and done-past todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. After I checked it, the list showed only the 'past' todo.
